annotation: Annotated on the raw video, before any perception output of the final method on this video was seen (the video was inspected once, qualitatively, in v1-baseline). Event times proposed by Claude from contact sheets and frame-by-frame crops of the raw video, then checked event by event by the author. The video has 2348 frames at about 30 fps; extracted frame fNNNN is video frame 30 * NNNN (f0000 to f0078). Definitions as in configs/assembly_2_events.json: touch = first frame the hand touches the piece, in the contact that ends with the piece lifted; pick = first frame the piece leaves the table; insert = first frame the piece touches the part it is mounted on (for the base: first frame it rests at the work position); hands_off = hands leave the figure; tol = estimate of the ambiguity of the events, in frames. mount = the piece reaches its final position (seated or pushed in); it is informative only and not used to choose frames. touch and pick are null when they happen outside the frame; first_seen is then the first frame the piece is visible in hand. Sides are in image coordinates.
